Cornel West reflects on resisting political hatred, greed, and spectacle—describing Trump as an embodiment of those forces—while urging a response rooted in love, compassion, and moral discipline. Drawing on philosophical and civil rights traditions, he calls for a “noble discontent” that refuses to mirror idolatry with more idolatry, and instead centers human dignity and service! #TruthJusticeLove
@kbla1580 @tavissmiley
